content: To avoid overfitting with some dataset, we train NCEL using collected Wikipedia hyperlinks instead of specific annotated data. We then evaluate the trained model on five different benchmarks to verify the linking precision as well as the generalization ability. Furthermore, we investigate the effectiveness of key modules in NCEL and give qualitative results for comprehensive analysis.
